question: Tenemos datos cuantitativos del turismo cultural en España y Barcelona?

methodology.scope: Only evidence files already present in the workspace (no live scraping in this step).
methodology.definition_note: No single official 'cultural tourism' metric was found for Spain in the INE FRONTUR/EGATUR press-release captures. For Barcelona, OTB monthly profile PDFs contain an activity indicator 'Visites culturals' (multiple response). For Spain, we add cultural participation and cultural-system indicators (museums visits, public cultural spending) as quantitative context, clearly labeled as non-tourism.
parsing_notes: OTB 'Visites culturals' extracted from PDF-to-text captures; each report contains three repeated 'Activitats realitzades al municipi' blocks for Barcelona Ciutat, Barcelona Regió, and Destinació Barcelona.
EHPC (Encuesta de Hábitos y Prácticas Culturales 2024-2025) metric extracted from evidence/02011.xlsx by parsing the underlying OOXML sheet1.xml (inlineStr headers + numeric cells).
Museum visitor totals and public cultural spending extracted from CulturaJaxiPx direct CSV_SC exports (evidence/T11P1010.csv_sc and evidence/T301001.csv_sc).
Eurostat COFOG GF08 (recreation, culture and religion) extracted from Eurostat dissemination JSON captures.

otb_activity_share_visites_culturals.source: Observatori del Turisme a Barcelona (OTB) — Informe mensual perfil Destinació (Abril 2026)
otb_activity_share_visites_culturals.indicator: Activitats realitzades al municipi (Resposta múltiple): Visites culturals

otb_activity_share_visites_culturals.source: Observatori del Turisme a Barcelona (OTB) — Informe mensual perfil Destinació (Maig 2026)
otb_activity_share_visites_culturals.indicator: Activitats realitzades al municipi (Resposta múltiple): Visites culturals

no_cultural_tourism_segmentation_in_ine_.note: This only indicates absence in these specific local captures, not absence in all official statistics.

cultural_participation_context.source: Ministerio de Cultura (Spain) — Encuesta de Hábitos y Prácticas Culturales 2024-2025 (CulturaJaxiPx XLSX export)
cultural_participation_context.indicator: Personas según la asistencia o visita… (TOTAL): han visitado en el último año
cultural_participation_context.unit: En % del total de cada colectivo

cultural_system_context.source: Ministerio de Cultura (Spain) — Estadística de Museos y Colecciones Museográficas (CSV_SC export)
cultural_system_context.indicator: Visitantes estimados en Museos y Colecciones Museográficas (TOTAL)

cultural_system_context.source: Ministerio de Cultura (Spain) — Estadística de financiación y gasto público en cultura (CSV_SC export)
cultural_system_context.indicator: Gasto liquidado en cultura — Administración General del Estado — TOTAL (en miles de euros)
General government expenditure: Recreation, culture and religion (GF08) — Percentage of GDP
General government expenditure: Recreation, culture and religion (GF08) — Percentage of total expenditure

limitations: Barcelona OTB indicator is an activity share from a survey/profile; it is not directly comparable to national tourist-arrivals totals.
Spain cultural participation metrics are about residents (survey) and are not tourism counts.

The XLSX extract (02011) is one specific table under EHPC 2024-2025 and does not cover monuments/archives in this extract; other tables exist (02004–02012 etc.) in the CulturaDynPx listing but were not downloaded here.
All metrics are bounded to the local evidence snapshots and may not reflect subsequent revisions.
